At lambda=0 the old core is preserved exactly by low moments. At other
lambda values the core basis changes with M: its represented low moments
are matched, but the unrepresented exact core may change. The old full map
is projected in the same material chart, and a recorded inlet correction
initializes the new core; this is an initial guess, not an exact map identity.

A fixed positive lambda and the frozen projection P_J define one nested
core family. The old compact combination is re-expressed by its exact
defining moments, preserving the entire core before solving. The old full
map is projected in the same material chart; all actual core and map
embedding errors are reported.
